Multiple Road Accidents Claim Lives and Injuries Across India

Multiple road accidents have resulted in fatalities and injuries across India. In Jharkhand, six people died in two separate road accidents. Separately, in Rajouri, Jammu and Kashmir, a vehicle plunged into a gorge, killing two individuals and injuring five others. Another incident in Rajouri saw a vehicle skid off the road, injuring six people, with four reported to be in critical condition.
